kind: Modeled continuation validation, not posted ION operating days
input: Closing state of the fresh V4.2 day-one physical calculation
method: Days two and three directly carry the prior final state; no call to opening/WIP initialization. Normal nine-hour production, same declared inbound supply and fixed 934 assets/3250 workers.
finding: Day three certification declined to 196 after opening downstream WIP was drawn down. Upstream output, local ingredient delivery and reserved traffic/finite buffers constrain flow even while raw warehouses contain stock. No inventory or capacity was invented to force the source target.
harnessNote: A first day-three continuation comparison failed on cross-VM object prototypes, after simulation completed. The harness now compares exact serialized state values and immutability, which match the portable-save contract. Day three was rerun successfully from the saved day-two closing state.
